name: Zhuhai Jinwan Airport
before:
One of the five major airports in the Pearl River Delta, about 50 km south west of central Zhuhai and 25 km south west of Macau.

The important thing to know before booking: despite having facilities for international flights, the airport currently serves only Chinese domestic routes. An international client cannot arrive here directly.

Access improved sharply in February 2024, when the Zhuhai to Zhuhai Airport intercity railway began running to a station at the airport. Four airport express bus routes also serve the city centre and the hotels at Xiangzhou, Gongbei, Jida and Tangjiawan, with connections to the Guangzhou-Zhuhai intercity railway, the Jiuzhou ferry port for Hong Kong and the Gongbei border crossing. Intercity coaches reach Macau, Zhongshan and Jiangmen.

The airport hosts the China International Aviation and Aerospace Exhibition, the largest airshow in mainland China.

The terminal was expanded to 122,000 square metres in 2018, with a further new terminal and runway planned. The China Coast Guard also operates from the site.
after:
Zhuhai's airport, about 50 km south west of central Zhuhai and 25 km south west of Macau.

The important thing to know before booking: the airport currently serves only Chinese domestic routes, so an international client cannot arrive here directly.

Airport express coaches run to Zhuhai, Macau, Zhongshan and Jiangmen.

Zhuhai hosts the China International Aviation and Aerospace Exhibition, held every two years since 1996.
